text_block_list.text:
After training,
visited library to do some research—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
World is so marvelous☆
As long as alive, it's marvelooous★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Day's finally ending,
yet someone's still full of energy...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ah, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Are you super marvelous, Nature?
I'm totally marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah... Plain average here.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So, what're you writing?
Let's see... "World Marvelous Proj—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "World Marvelous Project"!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
World is full of marvelous! But nobody
notices! Such huge waste!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uh, no clue...
What even is "marvelous" anyway—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Marvelous means "wonder"! Miracles,
happiness, good luck! All that is marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Think about it. First Big Bang
happened, right? Earth forming from that is
1 in 10 to 150,000th power chance! Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Then chance of life emerging on Earth
is 1 in 10 to 40,000th power! Pure miracle,
nothing else to call it!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Plus birth of Horse Girls is truly astonishing!
Beyond words marvelous☆
So point is—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... sorry, lost track of
what you're saying...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And somehow... getting sleepy...
Why... though—...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Huh! Where am I...?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo, Nature☆
This is Marvelous Space★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Are you looking for sparkly
marvelous? Or pure pure marvelous?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eh? Ah, pretty sure neither—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Honest Nature!
Good girl, good girl!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Special gift for honest Nature☆
Here, one and only glittering marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, make no sense, legit creepy...
Am I dreaming...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Ah.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
Back to normal...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Morning, Nature★
Looked super marvelous and peaceful sleeping☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Must have fallen asleep in marvelous mood
since I was talking marvelous☆
Ahaha★ Ahahahaha~☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, haha...
...Marvelous is downright terrifying...
